Home.hookQuestion: Do you know if ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini recommend your business when someone asks about your city?
Home.hookSub: We'll show you in a couple of minutes, for free.
Home.whatWeDoBody: Initial audit → technical and content fixes → ongoing monitoring with reports, so your business shows up more and better in AI engine answers when someone asks something related to your industry and city.
Home.step1Body: We run the real questions your customers ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity about your industry and city.
Home.step2Body: Whether you were mentioned, from which source, and why — the engine's actual answer, not a guess.
Home.step3Title: 3. We fix it and track it
Home.step3Body: A prioritized plan of what to fix first, with monthly tracking to see your score move.
Home.exampleNote: Sample data to show what the report looks like — not a real business.
Home.guaranteeTitle: What we guarantee, and what we don't
Home.guaranteeBody: We can't control which business an AI recommends — neither OpenAI nor Google offer that guarantee in their own systems, so neither do we. What we can control is how complete, consistent, structured, and verifiable the information an AI finds about your business is — and measure it month over month.
Home.forWhomBody: Any physical or digital business — professionals, local shops, online stores, or apps — that wants to know if an AI recommends them when someone asks about their industry and city.

Precios.title: Pricing
Precios.priceAtCheckout: Price available at checkout (USD, automatic conversion).
Precios.featuresLite: Monthly measurement (5-10 questions) · 1 location or up to 20 SKUs
Precios.featuresPlus: Bi-weekly measurement (15-30 questions) · 1 established location or 20-300 SKUs
Precios.featuresEnterprise: Daily measurement + alerts · 15+ locations or 3,000+ SKUs
Precios.agencyTitle: Are you an agency, or do you manage several businesses?
Precios.agencyBody: If you manage several businesses and want to use Radar IA at scale, there's a partner/reseller model with API or white-label access in exchange for a fee or revenue share. Reach out to talk through the details.
